$comment: d2e runtime config for Atlas3. Copied verbatim to resources/atlas/config-local.json by scripts/postinstall.js (Atlas3 fetches ./config-local.json at boot). api.url is RELATIVE so Atlas3 talks to WebAPI through d2e's Caddy->trex on the same origin (/WebAPI). The OpenID provider is WebAPI's own user/login/openid: trex is now the identity provider WebAPI authenticates against directly, so Atlas3 no longer needs the standalone login bridge or a token exchange step in between.
